top_reviews.text: Ok. LOVE this shoe. Super cozy, extra cushion AND stylish. Some reviews said to go up a size because they are narrow in the toe, but I have skinny and flat feet and my “normal” shoe size is a perfect fit.

top_reviews.title: Loyal Anne Klein shoe buyer
top_reviews.text: Anne Klein does it right every time. I can order online because it always has the same fit. These shoes are super comfortable and look really nice. I’ve tried many other brands for my work shoes and Anne is the only one who gets me, comfy and stylish and never a need to “break in” her shoes.

top_reviews.title: Disappointed
top_reviews.text: I am amazed to see how much the quality of Anne Klein products have deteriorated! I bought two pairs of AK shoes. Surprised to see that that the shoes had hardly any friction on the  soles!!! Getting things made in China is not serving the customers but definitely stuffing the pockets of higher level management and owners. The shoes run small. The sole is thin smooth piece of plastic.. Poor quality and watch out very slippery even on dry hard wood floor or ceramic tiles. Personally I will look for higher end shoes that are made in Europe or USA, may be pricy but will be reliable, safe, and worth the money.
